sources.title: Growing London's economy in a way that benefits all
sources.verified_claim: Draft London Plan chapter 4 proposes policies for employment space, industrial land, affordable workspace, skills and economic growth, while explicitly remaining a draft consultation document.

sources.title: Creating a greener, healthier, and resilient city
sources.verified_claim: Draft London Plan chapter 5 includes energy efficiency, low-carbon heat, whole-life carbon, heat risk, flood risk/drainage and biodiversity policies; these are draft regional policies, not parcel determinations.

sources.title: Place visions and place-based approaches
sources.verified_claim: Draft chapter 6 includes brownfield-first Opportunity Areas, town centres/high streets, strategic economic clusters, industrial land supporting housing growth and Metropolitan Open Land policies.

sources.title: London Plan Evidence
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's evidence page lists current July 2026 supporting evidence, including operational energy, whole-life carbon, regional flood risk, urban greening and parking-policy evidence, providing freshness context without proving parcel applicability.

sources.title: London Plan consultation portal
sources.verified_claim: The official engagement portal confirms chapter-by-chapter representations are open and consultation closes at 17:00 on 15 October 2026, reinforcing that the 2026 plan is still under consultation.

sources.title: Fastest infrastructure building in a generation as planning rules overhauled
sources.verified_claim: Government announced reforms intended to accelerate major infrastructure consenting, including changes coming into effect in July 2026; this is process context and not evidence that any specific local project will be delivered.

sources.title: Planning and Regeneration Committee
sources.verified_claim: The London Assembly committee's live page confirms current scrutiny of planning and regeneration and records July 2026 work including the New Towns report; it is governance context, not parcel evidence.

sources.title: Draft London Plan
sources.verified_claim: The master Draft London Plan page confirms publication status Draft, publication date 16 July 2026, and links the full housing, economy, resilience and place-based chapters.
